newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Four killed in clan fighting in Somalia.
newsitem.headline: Four killed in clan fighting in Somalia.

text.p: Four people were killed and two wounded in fighting between rival clan militiamen in a village in central Somalia, travellers from the region said on Thursday.
The travellers, arriving in the capital Mogadishu, said 50 Hawadle clan militiamen with two "technical" battlewagons on Wednesday attacked Abadlei village, 45 km (27 miles) north of Belet Huen town.
Travellers said six other people were missing after several villagers jumped into a river to escape the fighting. Both sides have argued over the ownership of farmland near the village.
Somalia has had no central government since the overthrow of its late dictator and president Mohamed Siad Barre in 1991.
